name: Hat bang
summary: The kernel of the bàng fruit, roasted with salt or candied and sold by the bag at the daily market. Prisoners once gathered the leaves and fruit when they were kept without greens.
origin: Côn Đảo. The kernel of trái bàng, roasted with salt or candied.
history: Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025, says prisoners gathered the leaves and the fruit when they were kept without greens. Vietnam Tourism says they also used the leaves as insulation, as paper, and to mark the year. Today the island roasts the kernels with salt or candies them.
culture: It is the souvenir visitors take home, packed by traders at chợ Côn Đảo. In peak season some kernels are bought in from the eastern and western provinces, so not every bag is island fruit. Vietnam Tourism says the tree fruits in July and August.
howToEat: Buy a bag of roasted or candied kernels as a gift. It is a snack to carry home, not a sit-down dish.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
priceBand: 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram, depending on the type (Báo Đồng Nai, July 2025).
seoTitle: Hat bang — roasted and candied kernels from Con Dao
seoDescription: Hạt bàng is the bàng kernel, roasted with salt or candied, packed at the Côn Đảo daily market for 250,000–400,000 đồng per kilogram.
